data.description: A marid can transform into a vortex of swirling, churning water once every 10 mintues. This ability functions identically to the whirlwind ability (10-50 ft. tall, 1d8+4 damage, DC %1, see page 306 for full details on this special attack), save that it can only be used while the marid is underwater; a marid cannot leave a body of water while in vortex form.
data.name: Vortex
